summary: POP generator for points arranged as a circle, ellipse, or arc, with optional point primitives, lines, line strip, or surface connectivity plus normal, tangent, and texture-coordinate attributes.

key_params.name: connectivity
key_params.note: None, Point Primitives, Surface, Line Strip, or Lines.

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: XY, YZ, or ZX plane orientation.

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use an input POP bounding box as the circle bounds.

key_params.name: divs
key_params.note: Number of circle or arc divisions.

key_params.name: closed
key_params.note: Connect the last vertex back to the first.

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Create normal attributes and choose class.

key_params.name: normaldirection
key_params.note: Default, radial, or tangent normal direction.

key_params.name: tangent
key_params.note: Create tangent attributes and choose class.

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Create texture coordinate attributes and choose class.

common_gotchas: Closed connects the last vertex/section to the first; turn it off for open arcs or partial curves.
Modify Bounds only applies when an input POP is connected and uses that input bounding box before additional translate, rotate, or scale changes.
Generate normal, tangent, and texture coordinate attributes deliberately when the output will be rendered or shaded downstream.
Use official internal parameter names such as rad, divs, and orient rather than display labels like radius, divisions, and orientation.
Use a Null POP output after Circle POP so downstream Render Simple TOP or shader references remain stable.
